title: Ambassador Program
description: Think of someone who's figuring out what's next. It takes about ten minutes to join, we'll give you the words, and there's a pin we're building toward together.

title: Ambassador
Program
hero.pinAlt: The pin, floating and turning to follow your pointer
hero.lede: A volunteer community for people who love to share a good thing.

mission.title: Spark curiosity.
mission.alt: Teal cat-eye enamel glowing into ink, with fine teal glitter

mission.title: Build community.
mission.alt: A raised nickel line tracing the swoosh over red enamel

mission.title: Inspire confidence.
mission.alt: Red cat-eye enamel with fine red glitter

you.title: It starts with you.
you.lede: Someone once got you curious. Now think of who might be next. Being an ambassador gives back in three ways.

items.label: As a professional
items.title: Skills that go with you.
items.body: Telling your story, leading a conversation, listening well. You'll use them everywhere.

items.label: As a neighbor
items.title: A say in what gets built.
items.body: What you hear from people helps shape what The Labs works on next.

items.label: As a person
items.title: Confidence that grows.
items.body: Share your story, and find out you can hold a room.

argument.title: You found your way.
argument.body: You showed up and did the work, and The Labs made room for you. Now you know the way in.

argument.title: Be the one who says “come with me.”
argument.body: No pitch needed. Just a friendly face they already trust.

argument.title: Help it reach the next neighborhood.
argument.body: The Labs grows one neighborhood at a time, whenever someone like you invites others in.

argument.title: Be early to something built to last.
argument.body: It's a year old, run by volunteers, and meant to be around for a long time. Everyone you bring adds another pair of hands.

labs.title: Worth being curious about.
labs.lede: It's free, run by volunteers, and it started in a public library a year ago.

habits.title: We decide together.
habits.body: Everyone gets a say in which problems we work on.

habits.title: We learn by building.
habits.body: We build real things for real problems, and make them to last.

habits.title: We pass it on.
habits.body: Whatever we learn, we share with the next person.

ripple.title: One conversation. Then a network.
ripple.lede: Each person you bring in often brings someone too.

rings.title: Someone you know
rings.body: One conversation, and their first workshop.

rings.title: Your neighbors
rings.body: A small team, which we call a pod, working on a real local problem.

rings.title: Everywhere
rings.body: Every neighborhood, everywhere. The future of work is coming either way. This way, more people get a hand in shaping it.

ripple.note: America's first lending library began with a dozen neighbors teaching each other. The Labs began inside a library.
ripple.videoLabel: The Labs orb as a planet, teal glowing from its upper left and red from its lower right, at the centre of dense rings made of networks that orbit it. A pulse leaves the orb, travels node to node through each ring, and leaps across the gaps between rings in small arcs of light, like synapses firing.

team.title: Curiosity goes both ways.
team.lede: Every conversation is also a chance to listen. What you hear helps shape what The Labs works on.

roles.title: Talk with people.
roles.body: No script needed. Ask questions, and listen.

roles.title: Take the mic, once.
roles.body: Give one short talk to a group. We'll help you practice first.

roles.title: Share your name.
roles.body: When someone joins and mentions you, it counts toward your progress.

roles.title: Welcome the next ambassador.
roles.body: When you're ready, help someone new find their way in.

title: The button says you're in.
The pin is what we're building toward.
path.lede: A few small steps, each one celebrated. Your coordinator, a local volunteer lead, is with you the whole way.

steps.title: Raise your hand.
steps.body: Let us know you're interested. That's the whole first step.

steps.title: Join in.
steps.body: About ten minutes on your phone. Your coordinator gives you your Ambassador button.

steps.title: Get ready.
steps.body: Five short steps in the guide. About half an hour, whenever suits you.

steps.title: Pass it on.
steps.body: Invite [N] people to their first workshop, give one talk, and welcome one new ambassador.

steps.title: Help shape what's next.
steps.body: We're building toward a pin for people who help The Labs in more than one way. Our first ambassadors will help decide what it takes.

rewards.title: The button
rewards.body: Given to you in person by your coordinator. It's how ambassadors recognize each other.
rewards.alt: The ambassador button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and AMBASSADOR in white

rewards.title: The pin
rewards.body: A pin for people who help The Labs in more than one way, earned rather than bought. We're still working out the details, together with our first ambassadors.
rewards.alt: The pin: the orb mark with teal and red cat-eye enamel

goal.title: What we're building, together.

stats.label: new people learning with The Labs

goal.note: That's about two new people a week for each ambassador. And nobody does it alone.

faq.title: Questions you might have.

items.a: No. Being an ambassador is free, and so is everything at The Labs.

items.q: How much time does it take?
items.a: About ten minutes to join and half an hour to get ready. After that, it's mostly conversations you'd have anyway, plus one talk.

items.q: Do I have to sell anything?
items.a: Not at all. There's nothing for sale. Just share your story and point people to theupskillinglabs.org.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: Not at all. Curiosity and a story of your own are plenty.
It's what we're building toward: a pin for people who help The Labs in more than one way, earned rather than bought. Our first ambassadors will help shape it.
Yes, any time. You're always welcome back.
Your coordinator. You'll find their details in the guide.
